incident-bot: [PAGER] P1: org=solstice-42 experiencing sustained 5xx spike >10% and QPS surge. Auto-throttle triggered. Paging oncall: @eric. Dashboard: https://console.redwood/alerts/3423456789 :rotating_light:
eric (oncall): Oncall Eric here, seeing pager. Starting triage. Which customer endpoints?
eric (oncall): dashboard link ok — looks like /v1/generate and /v1/chat are hottest. QPS ~320 (baseline ~40), 5xx ~11-13% across nodes.
nina (support): Customer-facing reports: multiple customers reporting timeouts and errors since 12:02 UTC. Support ticket #CS-1194 linked to solstice contacts.
lee (sre): Copy. Root cause likely bursty fanout + per-org rate limiter hitting token exhaustion and fallback path failing. We can do targeted rate-limit override for solstice-42 for short window, or disable heavy reranker for them.
raj (eng-ops): Prefers targeted RL bump over disabling features — less risky for quality. Suggest bump from 2rps to 8rps for 10m, then observe. Also suggest gradual ramp to avoid downstream gradient.
eric (oncall): Agreed. Deploy short override, monitor 1m metrics, be ready to rollback. Nina, please confirm customer SLA tolerance.
nina (support): Solstice on Standard SLA; they reported degraded UX, want prioritized. Ok to proceed with mitigation.
lee (sre): Applying override via infra CLI.
lee (sre): ```
# apply per-org rate limit override
rictl rate-limit override create \
  --org solstice-42 \
  --requests-per-second 8 \
  --burst 20 \
  --duration 10m \
  --reason "emergency hotfix - traffic spike" \
  --owner lee
```
lee (sre): override id=ovr-9b7c applied. Propagating — should hit edge config in ~15s.
eric (oncall): Noted. Watching graphs.
(15s later)
lee (sre): Metrics: QPS for org now at ~300 (client still sending), 5xx rate dropped to 4.2%, p95 latency down 30%. :white_check_mark:. No immediate downstream worker OOMs observed.
raj (eng-ops): Good. One note: long-running KV cache miss causes backend latency spikes. Recommend enabling short-lived prefix cache for this org: TTL 30s.
lee (sre): I can set cache policy via config toggle. Doing: `rictl cache set --org solstice-42 --prefix-ttl 30s --owner lee`
lee (sre): Cache change applied. Cache hit rate for org increased from 12% -> 58% within 60s.
nina (support): Informing customer liaison that we've applied a temporary rate adjustment and cache optimization. They asked about feature disable — they prefer not to lose reranking quality.
eric (oncall): Keeping reranker ON. If error rate creeps back up, we will consider disabling reranker-v2 for only mutate-heavy routes.
(5m monitor)
lee (sre): 5m stable window: 5xx 2.1%, errors trending down, overall system load within headroom. Plan: hold override for full 10m then reassess.
raj (eng-ops): Also toggled traffic shaping to smooth bursts: `trafficctl shape set --org solstice-42 --max-burst 30 --smoothing 0.7` — applied.
eric (oncall): Good. Start documenting actions for post-incident notes.
lee (sre): At T+10m overriding window expired. Removing override now: `rictl rate-limit override delete --id ovr-9b7c --owner lee`
lee (sre): Override removed. Observing metrics. 5xx remains ~2.5%, QPS normalized to ~60 after they backoff. No regressions.
eric (oncall): Confirming no customer-visible errors in last 3m. Nina, can you check CS ticket and update them?
nina (support): Will update CS-1194: applied temp rate-limit override, cache tweak, traffic shaping. Customer confirmed improvements.
eric (oncall): Handoff to next oncall Maya for follow-up and postmortem. Key items: runbook link https://confluence.redwood/ops/runbooks/org-spike-mitigation, override id ovr-9b7c, cache change marker, customer CS-1194. Monitor for 30m then close incident.
maya (oncall-next): Acked. Will monitor dashboards and confirm closure.
eric (oncall): Thanks team :pray: — marking incident resolved at 12:28 UTC pending final confirmation.
incident-bot: Incident auto-note: mitigation actions recorded (override=ovr-9b7c, cache_change=yes, traffic_shaping=yes). Close window set to 30m. Logs: https://console.redwood/logs/incident/3423456789
